messages:
Noah (Design): Quick QA of the new trace drilldown layout I pushed. Main asks: is the 'frame grouping' affordance clear, and does the permalink + export flow feel discoverable?

Rhea (Eng): I skimmed it — frame grouping is useful but the chevron is subtle. Users miss the collapsed count. Maybe explicit text like '12 frames collapsed (expand)'.

Kai (Product): Agree. Also we should surface the permalink as a small chain icon next to the trace title. When clicked, show a tiny modal with link + expiry options.

Maya (Accessibility): A11y nits: chain icon needs aria-label and keyboard focus. The collapse affordance must be a button with aria-expanded and descriptive label. Tooltips must be accessible.

Noah (Design): Good call — I'll change chevrons to inline text for counts and make the icon secondary. For permalink modal copy: title 'Share trace snapshot', primary 'Create link', include 'Expires in' selector.

Rhea (Eng): Implementation note: streaming downloads for large traces. We shouldn't materialize full JSON client-side. Server will provide a streaming endpoint. Also for collapse, we'll dedupe on client when traces are under 1k spans, server aggregation for >1k.

Kai (Product): Copy tweak: change 'Export' to 'Snapshot & download' to set expectations. Add small warning: 'May contain sensitive headers'. Default scrub for enterprise.

Maya (Accessibility): Make sure the warning is announced to screen readers (aria-live) when toggled. Also contrast: error badge color fails at 12px. Use darker red or bold text per WCAG.

Noah (Design): I'll update the mock to use a higher-contrast badge and add an aria-live region for export warnings. Also adding a small hover card on the timeline scrubber showing time and span count.

Rhea (Eng): I'll add focus handling for scrubber and the keyboard-friendly hover card. Also will expose an option to 'Search by correlation ID' when clicking the ID; default is project-scoped, with org scope gated by permission.

Kai (Product): Telemetry: please track 'create_link', 'download_snapshot', 'expand_collapsed_frames', 'search_by_correlation_id'. We'll use it to tune defaults.

OpsBot: Deployed trace-ui/compact-frames to staging.

Noah (Design): Thanks, team. I'll iterate and post updated frames in Figma. Anyone who wants to run a quick screen-reader pass, ping me once PR is up. :sparkles:
